title: Sell Mineral Rights in Valencia, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Valencia, PA
metaDescription: Own mineral rights in Valencia, Butler County? We buy Marcellus interests directly from families, straightforward cash offers, no pressure.
heroLead: Valencia sits in the part of Butler County where the Marcellus play starts to thin out and older, shallower gas history takes over, which makes a straightforward-looking deed here sometimes more complicated than it first appears.
intro: Valencia is a small borough in Butler County, north of Pittsburgh, in an area where farmland has historically supported both agriculture and, at various points over the last century and a half, small-scale oil and gas production. Butler County's oil history dates back to the boom years of the late 1800s, and modern Marcellus development has layered new leases and units on top of decades-old shallow well arrangements in places.

The wet-gas Marcellus window doesn't run as thick through this part of Butler County as it does further south in Washington and Greene counties, so development pacing and unit density around Valencia can look different from what families further south hear about from friends or relatives.

sections.heading: Older Shallow Wells and Newer Marcellus Units
paragraphs: If your family's Valencia-area property has an old, shallow gas well on it, or a lease tied to one, that arrangement is separate from any Marcellus-depth lease that might also apply. We review both layers carefully so we understand exactly what rights are in play before discussing a number.

sections.heading: Building a Fair Offer for This Part of the County
paragraphs: We check current DEP permits and unit filings against your specific parcel, review production history where it exists, and give you a straightforward cash offer with the reasoning explained clearly, rather than a number based on what a Washington County tract might be worth.

faqs.question: Is there an old shallow well already on my property? How would I know?
faqs.answer: The Pennsylvania DEP's well mapping records go back decades and often show historical shallow wells. We can check this against your parcel as part of reviewing your interest.

faqs.question: Is development around Valencia as active as it is further south in Washington County?
faqs.answer: Generally not to the same density, since this part of Butler County sits closer to the edge of the wet-gas window. We evaluate your specific parcel rather than assuming county-wide activity levels.

faqs.question: Can an old shallow lease and a new Marcellus lease both apply to my land at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes, leases can be depth-specific, meaning different agreements can cover different formations under the same surface property. We review both to determine what you're actually able to sell.
